verdict.rationale: Granola documents its own retention control: transcripts are auto-deleted after a chosen period from 1 day to 1 year. Notes can be permanently deleted or restored. However, auto-deletion explicitly applies only to transcripts, so notes stay unless removed manually. Missing for 10: configurable retention for notes and summaries, documented details of how deletion and legal holds work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time.
Choose a retention period from the dropdown: 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year
This applies only to transcripts — your notes are not affected and will remain available.
Permanently remove notes or recover accidentally deleted ones.
